Translation: Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Ungli Pakar Ke Chalaaya, Seene Se Tum Ne Lagaaya
Inn Teen Saalon Mein Amma, Tum Ne Bohat Kuch Sikhaaya
Maa Se Bichhar Ke, Jeete Hain Kaise, Kya Yeh Sikhaati Hai Maa
Translation:
Holding my finger you taught me to walk, you held me to your chest
In these three years, Mother, you taught me so much
How to live once parted from one's mother - does Mother teach this?
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Darwaaza Jab Se Gira Hai, Pehlu Shikasta Huwa Hai
Tooti Huwi Pasliyaan Hain, Shabbir Sab Jaanta Hai
Takleef Mein Hoon, Bachon Ko Apne, Kab Yeh Bataati Hai Maa
Translation:
Ever since the door fell, her side has been broken
Her ribs are broken - Shabbir (AS) knows it all
"I am in pain" - when does Mother tell this to her children?
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Iss Fikar Mein Jaag Jaana, Pyaasa Na Ho Mera Beta
Ehsaas Hai Mujhko Amma, Kya Pyaar Hota Hai Maa Ka
Raaton Ko Uth Kar, Bete Ko Apne, Paani Pilaati Hai Maa
Translation:
Waking up worried that my son may be thirsty
I feel, Mother, what a mother's love is
Rising night after night, Mother gives her son water to drink
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Qissa Mujhe Ek Maa Ka, Bhaiyya Hasan Ne Sunaaya
Beta Wahin Saamne Tha, Jab Maa Ne Khaaya Tamaacha
Ab Apne Ghar Mein, Beton Se Apna, Chehra Chhupaati Hai Maa
Translation:
Brother Hasan (AS) told me the story of a mother
Her son was right there before her when Mother was slapped
Now, in her own home, Mother hides her face from her sons
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Jab Se Laga Taaziyaana, Mushkil Tha Mujhko Sulaana
Jab Haath Dekha Tumhaara, Tab Jaa Ke Maine Yeh Jaana
Hon Haath Zakhmi, Phir Bhi Thapak Kar, Lori Sunaati Hai Maa
Translation:
Ever since the whip struck, it was hard to put me to sleep
Only when I saw your hand did I come to know this
Even when her hands are wounded, still, patting her child, Mother sings a lullaby
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Shabbir Ne Phir Sada Di, Kya Chor Jaaogi Tum Bhi
Kyun Aisa Kehti Ho Amma, Rehti Nahin Maa Kisi Ki
Achha Bataao, Kya Door Jaa Ke, Phir Laut Aati Hai Maa
Translation:
Then Shabbir (AS) called out: "Will you too leave us behind?
Why do you say this, Mother - that no one's mother remains?
All right, tell me - once she goes far away, does Mother ever come back?"
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Maa Ne Kaha Phir Yeh Shabbir Se, Har Maa To Aati Nahin Laut Ke
Aye Mere Dil, Mere Noor-e-Nazar, Zahra Ka Ab Tum Se Waada Hai Yeh
Jab Tum Bulaaoge, Aayegi Maa, Seene Se Tum Ko Lagaayegi Maa
Translation:
Then Mother said this to Shabbir (AS): "Not every mother comes back
O my heart, light of my eyes, Zahra (AS) now promises you this:
When you call, Mother will come, Mother will hold you to her chest"
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Ek Roz Aisa Bhi Aaya, Tha Fatima Ka Janaaza
Rukh Se Kafan Jab Hataaya, Shabbir Ne Maa Se Poocha
Zer-e-Kafan Bhi, Aawaaz Sun Kar, Aansoo Bahaati Hai Maa
Translation:
One day, such a day came too: it was the funeral of Bibi Fatema (AS)
When the shroud was drawn from her face, Shabbir (AS) asked his mother
Even beneath the shroud, on hearing the voice, Mother sheds tears
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Zahra Ki Turbat Pe Jaa Kar, Dekha Ali Ne Yeh Aksar
Shabbir Lipte Huwe Hain, Kehte Hain Amma Chalo Ghar
Tum Jaanti Ho, Sota Hoon Main Jab, Mujhko Sulaati Hai Maa
Translation:
Going to the grave of Zahra (AS), Ali (AS) often saw this:
Shabbir (AS) clinging to it, saying, "Mother, come home
You know that when I sleep, it is Mother who lulls me to sleep"
Why does Mother leave us behind?

Original:
Bin Maa Ke Bachon Se Aa Ke, Jab Haal Poocha Ali Ne
Haaye Raza Aur Zeeshan, Shabbir Ro Ro Ke Bole
Aye Baba Ghar Mein, Lagta Nahin Dil, Jab Yaad Aati Hai Maa
Translation:
When Ali (AS) came and asked the motherless children how they were
Alas, O Raza and Zeeshan - Shabbir (AS), weeping bitterly, said
"O Father, my heart cannot settle at home when Mother comes to mind"
Why does Mother leave us behind?
